title.it: Smartbox comunica un accesso non autorizzato alla propria piattaforma
title.en: Smartbox reports unauthorised access to its platform

description.it: Smartbox ha comunicato un accesso abusivo a una piattaforma con possibile consultazione di nomi ed email dei clienti; secondo la società non erano accessibili password né dati delle carte. Non emerge evidenza pubblica di un collegamento tecnico con BBT SE, con le minacce a figure pubbliche o con la refrigerazione: registrato come contesto sulle intrusioni, non come parte di una campagna statale unitaria.
description.en: Smartbox reported unauthorised access to a platform with possible viewing of customers' names and emails; according to the company, passwords and card data were not accessible. No public evidence emerges of a technical link with BBT SE, with the threats against public figures or with refrigeration: recorded as context on intrusions, not as part of a unitary state campaign.

notes: Fonte_09 OEM26-007, update type NEW_EVENT. Evidence level of the main link per Fonte_09: E1 dichiarazione aziendale.
Themes, places and the single evidence_level (the lower of any pair given) were assigned editorially from the Fonte_09 text.
Exact date of the access not stated in Fonte_09 (range 3–7 November from the quick register).
The company's own statement was not acquired; the source is a press report.
